description: Land Title Settlement Department - Keselpotha South (Track II), Riseegama 1:yadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad Mad No. 710009 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels (with parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) and declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding land title determinations. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, title settlements, and property ownership matters.
